caption:
Wow, this feeling is indescribable and words can’t even come close enough to express my love for Eagleville and my love for this team. ❤️ 

Ending my high school softball career at Eagleville is one of the most meaningful chapters of my life, this journey has left an unforgettable mark. Playing for Eagleville wasn’t just about playing softball it was about being part of a family, surrounded by incredible teammates, dedicated coaches, and a supportive community that truly felt like home. Every practice, every game, every gate and every moment spent on that field taught me lessons about teamwork, perseverance, and passion that I will carry with me forever. Not only has Eagleville taught me so many thing’s, but  the friendships I formed, the challenges I overcame, and the celebrations we shared created memories that go far beyond the sport itself. The spirit of Eagleville’s community, with their encouragement and pride, made me feel valued and motivated to give my best every single day no matter what. Leaving behind this chapter is bittersweet, but I know the impact this experience has had on my life and will continue to impact me everyday and  will last a lifetime shaping not only my love for softball but also my character and confidence moving forward. Being able to look up at the stands in my last inning ever to pitch for Eagleville softball will always hold a special place in my heart, because when I look up I see a family that would do anything for our community and that is what makes Eagleville. I am incredibly grateful for the incredible people and community that made this journey so extraordinary and I wouldn’t want to end my high school career any other way other than a 2x State champ. Thank you Jesus and thank you Eagleville. Once last time, #11 out. ❤️❤️❤️

caption:
Blake Ilitch is a 2025 RHP with a 6-4 215 lb. frame from Detroit, MI who attends Brother Rice. Large, athletic frame with long limbs and broadness to shoulders, present strength with additional room to fill. Right-handed pitcher, up-tempo delivery with leg lift up past belt, gathers on backside; plenty of arm speed through the back working to a higher release point. 

Fastball tops out at 95.4 mph and lives in the mid to low-90s, four-seamer takes off with riding life and carry at the top of the zone with upwards of 22” IVB in recent bullpens. The Curveball is difference maker, big 12-6 shape and sharp life with Vertical Break up to -25in and 2700rpms, true hammer up to 80mph and able to land for strikes with confidence. Short bullet slider in the mid 80s, can land for strikes. Can pitch backwards off of both breakers with conviction. In Addition has a Splitter in the low 80s with up to 800rpms and -2 Vertical Break. Further, he has Sweeper at 76mph with up to 2600rpms and Change up in the low 80s in his Arsenal as well, they he may Flash. I project Blake to be selected early to mid-day on Day 2 of the draft.

caption:
Dominant pitcher👀

Blake Ilitch is a big-time arm out of Detroit, Michigan, standing at 6’4” and 220 lbs, and pitching for Brother Rice High School. This guy is no secret—ranked #98 nationally by Baseball America and the top player in Michigan by Perfect Game. In 2024, he earned MaxPreps RHP All-American honors, and it’s easy to see why.

Blake is committed to Ole Miss, and he brings a special mix of power and polish on the mound. His fastball lights up radar guns at 95.4 mph, sitting comfortably 92-95 with ridiculous 18-inch vertical ride. He’s got a nasty curveball at 77-79 with -22 inches of vertical break and 2800 RPM spin, along with a sharp slider at 83-85 spinning at 2400 RPM. To top it off, his splitter, sitting at 79-81, shows filthy movement with -2 vertical and 15 horizontal break.

With his size, electric stuff, and competitive edge, Blake is the kind of pitcher you know has a bright future ahead. Ole Miss is getting a good one.
